title: Correction record
description: Applies to corrections/<YYYY>/cr-*.yaml. Correction records are append-only. A takedown record must not name the removed personal data.

type.description: withdrawal and republication are status changes of a published ID (R104, R105). A tool writes them.

made_by.description: An editor record names its merge request. A tool record is written by a tool and names the gate and the rule.

gate.description: The gate counter that failed, for example rejected_no_gov_actor.

rule_id.description: The rule that required the correction, for example R82.
